skill_name: Summarize the advantages and disadvantages of long-term unemployment.
workflow: Long-term unemployment can have both positive and negative effects. On the plus side, people who are unemployed for a long period of time can use this opportunity to upskill and improve their resumes. They also may have a greater focus on personal development, such as hobbies and volunteer work. However, long-term unemployment can have a significant impact on one's sense of self-worth and mental health, as well as their finances.
